meta.name: creative-thinking-for-research
meta.description: Applies cognitive science frameworks for creative thinking to CS and AI research ideation. Use when seeking genuinely novel research directions by leveraging combinatorial creativity, analogical reasoning, constraint manipulation, and other empirically grounded creative strategies.

copy.tagline: 用认知科学框架激发研究创意
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在寻找新颖的CS/AI研究方向
copy.tagline_en: Spark research ideas with cognitive science frameworks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're seeking novel CS/AI research directions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会使用认知科学中的八种创造力框架（如组合、类比、约束操作等）来帮你生成计算机和 AI 研究的新想法。它会引导你系统性地探索非传统的方向。
howto.when: 当你需要真正新颖的研究思路，而不是对现有工作的增量改进时触发。适合在感到思维陷入局部最优、或准备进行学术头脑风暴时使用。

say.text: 帮我用组合创造力框架，把生物学和机器学习结合起来。
say.note: Claude 会引导你列出两个领域的概念并生成交叉矩阵。

say.text: 我当前的研究问题是提升 Transformer 效率，请用问题重构框架分析。
say.note: Claude 会帮你识别隐藏假设并生成替代表述。

say.text: 用类比推理框架，为我的问题寻找远距离领域的结构映射。
say.note: Claude 会引导你剥离领域术语，搜索结构匹配。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses eight cognitive science frameworks (e.g., combinatorial creativity, analogical reasoning, constraint manipulation) to help you generate novel research ideas in CS and AI. It guides you through systematic exploration of non-obvious directions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you seek genuinely novel research ideas beyond incremental extensions. Suitable when feeling stuck in a local optimum or preparing for a research retreat or PhD-level ideation session.

say_en.text: Use combinatorial creativity to combine biology and machine learning.
My current problem is improving Transformer efficiency; apply problem reformulation.
Use analogical reasoning to find a distant structural match for my problem.
